name: Public API
description: A read-only JSON API for your website or Discord: online players, status and leaderboards.
author: Console
permissions: Reads your server's status and player stats

settings.label: API key (optional)
settings.help: If set, callers must send it as the x-api-key header or ?key=. Leave blank for a fully public API.

settings.label: Allowed website (CORS)
settings.help: Use * for any site, or https://shop.yourdomain.com to allow only your website.

settings.label: Hide these players from leaderboards
settings.help: Comma separated, like staff or alt accounts.
